description: BreezeBlue (operated by RESONIA, INC.) builds the Breeze TTS 2 text-to-speech models. It sells a self-serve Developer API and Studio (HTTP, streaming and realtime WebSocket TTS, voice cloning, voice design and dubbing) priced per character, and publishes the bilingual English/Chinese Breeze TTS 2 weights under a research and non-commercial licence; the hosted multilingual model covers 51 languages.
name: BreezeBlue
